data.one_liner: Integrate Google Cast devices to discover, connect, and control media playback.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin for integrating Google Cast SDK on Android and iOS. Enables discovery of Chromecast and Cast-enabled devices, session management, and media streaming controls.
use_when: You need to stream media from your Flutter app to Chromecast and Google Cast-enabled receivers.
You require cross-platform device discovery and session management for Google Cast.
avoid_when: You need to integrate with non-Chromecast or DLNA devices (use media_cast_dlna instead).
You only need local audio or video playback without casting.
strengths: Supports cross-platform discovery and media streaming on Android and iOS.
Provides stream-based APIs for real-time status updates.
Includes modular imports to optimize bundle size and compile times.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration in Info.plist and AndroidManifest.xml.
Android Cast SDK-internal logs cannot be fully configured due to CAF limitations.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding permissions and metadata to AndroidManifest.xml and local network usage descriptions and Bonjour services configuration to iOS Info.plist.
